LanguageData.XTS_FilterArchiteDesc: Preset xenotypes with archite genes, such as sanguophages. Scenario xenotypes are grouped separately.
LanguageData.XTS_FilterInheritableDesc: Preset xenotypes whose genes are passed on to children, such as impids and yttakin. The baseliner xenogerm is listed here too, because it turns a person back into a baseliner.
LanguageData.XTS_FilterPlayerScenarioDesc: The custom xenotypes your starting colonists were created with. Xenotypes you assemble during the game will never be sold.
LanguageData.XTS_CustomXenotypeDesc: A custom xenotype your starting colonists were created with.
LanguageData.XTS_PricingSectionDesc: The market value of xenogerms sold by traders.
LanguageData.XTS_BasePresetValueDesc: The silver added to the market value of every xenogerm sold by traders.
LanguageData.XTS_ValuePerMetabolismDesc: The silver added for each point of metabolic efficiency, positive or negative.
LanguageData.XTS_ValuePerComplexityDesc: The silver added for each point of complexity.
LanguageData.XTS_ValuePerArchiteDesc: The silver added for each archite gene.
LanguageData.XTS_QuantitySectionDesc: The number of xenogerms each kind of trader will stock, picked at random from its range.
LanguageData.XTS_TraderCountDesc: The number of xenogerms this trader will arrive with.
LanguageData.XTS_SettlementCountDesc: The number of xenogerms these settlements will keep in stock. Settlements restock about once a month.
LanguageData.XTS_PreserveDeathrestCapacityDesc: When enabled, a person will keep the deathrest capacity gained from serums when a xenogerm is implanted, as long as they still have the deathrest gene. When disabled, their deathrest capacity will reset to one.
LanguageData.XTS_ImplantGermlineAsEndogenesDesc: When enabled, a xenogerm for a germline xenotype will replace the person's germline genes, and their children will inherit them. Their existing xenogenes will be kept. When disabled, the genes will be implanted as xenogenes and will overwrite the existing ones.
LanguageData.XTS_CommonalitySectionDesc: How the price of a xenogerm changes the chance that a trader will stock it.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategyInversePriceDesc: Cheaper xenogerms will be much more common. Archite xenogerms will stay rare.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategySoftInversePriceDesc: Cheaper xenogerms will be somewhat more common.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategyPriceDesc: More expensive xenogerms will be much more common.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategySqrtPriceDesc: More expensive xenogerms will be somewhat more common.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategyBellCurveDesc: Xenogerms near the median price will be the most common. The cheapest and the most expensive will both be rare.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategyUniformDesc: Every sellable xenotype is equally likely, regardless of price.
